name: marketplaces
description: Search Ozon and Wildberries, inspect product cards with photos, and fetch reviews through local MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Search WB/Ozon, open product cards, images, and reviews
interface.longDescription: Adds local MCP tools for Ozon and Wildberries: paginated product search, full product-card inspection with image preview output, and review retrieval for both marketplaces. The installer opens a controlled browser login flow for both stores, saves cookies locally, installs Python dependencies into a private venv, and registers the plugin for Codex.
defaultPrompt: Search Ozon and Wildberries for this product and show the next page token.
Open this WB/Ozon product card and include the first product photo in the output.
Fetch reviews for this WB/Ozon product and include the first review photo if available.
